Estimated items on the tray:
- English muffin breakfast sandwich (muffin, ham or Canadian bacon, maybe cheese): about 200 kcal.
- Avocado, roughly half a fruit: about 120 kcal.
- Orange juice, about 8 oz: about 110 kcal.
- Canned peaches in a bowl, about 1/2 cup: about 70 kcal.

Served total is about 500 kcal. The photo shows the meal before eating, so I can't see what will be left. I assumed a small leftover of about 30 kcal (some avocado or peaches), which gives about 470 kcal eaten.

Macronutrients for the eaten portion:
- Protein: about 12 g (sandwich ~10 g, avocado ~1.5 g, juice ~1.5 g).
- Carbohydrate: about 62 g (muffin ~28 g, juice ~26 g, peaches ~17 g, avocado ~6 g, less the leftover).
- Fat: about 20 g (avocado ~11 g, sandwich ~7 g, and a little from the other items).
